SELECT "id", "customer_id", "invoice_number", "amount", "status", "method", "paid_at", "due_date", "reference", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at", count(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM {{table:payments}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("invoice_number"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("reference"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($7::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($7::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN $5::text = 'invoice_number' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "invoice_number" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'invoice_number' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "invoice_number" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'amount' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "amount" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'amount' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "amount" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'paid_at' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "paid_at" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'paid_at' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "paid_at" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'due_date' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "due_date" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'due_date' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "due_date" END DESC, id DESC
LIMIT $4::int OFFSET ((($3::int - 1) * $4::int))

SELECT "id", "customer_id", "invoice_number", "amount", "status", "method", "paid_at", "due_date", "reference", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:payments}} WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO {{table:payments}} ("customer_id", "invoice_number", "amount", "status", "method", "paid_at", "due_date", "reference", created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1::int, $2::text, $3::numeric, $4::text, $5::text, $6::timestamptz, $7::date, $8::text, now(), now())
RETURNING "id", "customer_id", "invoice_number", "amount", "status", "method", "paid_at", "due_date", "reference", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"

UPDATE {{table:payments}}
SET "customer_id" = $2::int, "invoice_number" = $3::text, "amount" = $4::numeric, "status" = $5::text, "method" = $6::text, "paid_at" = $7::timestamptz, "due_date" = $8::date, "reference" = $9::text, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL
RETURNING "id", "customer_id", "invoice_number", "amount", "status", "method", "paid_at", "due_date", "reference", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
UPDATE {{table:payments}} SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:payments}} SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:payments}} SET "status" = $2::text, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "status"
